sentiment: Rest is not a pause from living; it is the quiet soil where the next day learns to grow.

stories.title: Where Human Sleep Went Wrong
stories.summary: A meditation on how we broke our own rest — the deep rhythm of sleep pushed aside until it became the thing we chase instead of the thing we keep.

stories.title: Being ambitious and being a dad
stories.summary: An honest ledger of ambition and presence — the slow realization that the years you give to being there are not subtracted from a good life, they are the good life.

stories.title: Scientists stunned by children's lung recovery in ultra low emission zone
stories.summary: Cleaner air quietly restoring what was damaged — proof that the body keeps its own repair shop, and that removing harm is itself a kind of healing.
